test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: if A and B can do a piece of work in 20 days, and A alone can do the same work in 60 days, then in how many days can B alone complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

Work done by A and B together = 20 days

Work done by A alone = 60 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 20 and 60 is 60

Efficiency of A and B together = (60/20) units

⇒ 3 units/day

Efficiency of A alone = (60/60) units

⇒ 1 unit/day

B alone can complete a work = [60/(3 – 1)] days

⇒ (60/2) days

⇒ 30 days

**∴ B alone can complete a work in 30 days**
